name: Advanced Energy Solution Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced Energy Solution Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of lithium battery modules in Europe, Asia, the Americas, Oceania, China, Taiwan, Vietnam, and Africa. It offers industrial energy storage lithium-ion batteries, power lithium-ion batteries, precision molds, blisters, plastics, and plastic injection moldings; and spare parts, and related after-sales installation and maintenance services. The company also manufactures power generation, transmission, and distribution machinery; wired and wireless communications machinery and equipment; computer and peripheral equipment; automobiles and parts; bicycles and parts; and general instruments. In addition, it manufactures and wholesales electronic materials; provides energy technology services; and imports and exports goods and technology. Further, the company provides technical services, technology development, technical consultation, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion services; and manufactures and sells plastic products. Advanced Energy Solution Holding Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
